description: Deep Document Search turns ChatGPT into a powerful interface for your private document knowledge base. Search and analyze PDFs, Word files, scanned documents, and large document collections using natural language; find relevant information across thousands or millions of files; and get accurate, traceable answers with citations back to the original documents. It is built for document-intensive workflows such as legal research, regulatory compliance, corporate knowledge, due diligence, research, and document analysis.
